title: Area and Circumference of Circles
seo_title: Grade 7 Circles Worksheets: Area and Circumference with π, Radius and Diameter
standard_text: Know the formulas for the area and circumference of a circle and use them to solve problems; give an informal derivation of the relationship between the circumference and area of a circle.
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 circles worksheets: radius and diameter, circumference C = 2πr, area A = πr², answers in terms of π, working backward, semicircles and real-world problems. 100 practice questions with an answer key.
key_big: Circumference C = 2πr (distance around). Area A = πr² (space inside).
key_sub: π ≈ 3.14. If you are given the diameter, halve it to get the radius before finding the area.
body_html:
The parts of a circle

The radius goes from the center to the edge. The diameter goes all the way across, so it is twice the radius. For every circle, circumference ÷ diameter is the same number: π ≈ 3.14.

PartFormulaMeaning
RadiusrCenter to the edge
Diameterd = 2rAll the way across
CircumferenceC = 2πr = πdDistance around (units)
AreaA = πr2Space inside (square units)
Example

Find the circumference and area of a circle with radius 5 cm. Use 3.14 for π.

C = 2 × 3.14 × 5 = 31.4 cm.

A = 3.14 × 52 = 3.14 × 25 = 78.5 cm2.

Answer: C = 31.4 cm, A = 78.5 cm2

Example

A circle has diameter 12 m. Find its area.

First find the radius: 12 ÷ 2 = 6 m.

A = 3.14 × 62 = 3.14 × 36 = 113.04 m2.

Answer: 113.04 m2

Common mistakes

  • Using the diameter in A = πr2: halve it first.
  • Mixing the formulas: 2πr is the distance around, πr2 is the space inside.
  • Writing r2 as 2r: 52 = 25, not 10.
  • Forgetting square units for area.

faq.q: What is the formula for the circumference of a circle?
faq.a: C = 2πr or C = πd. A circle with radius 5 cm has circumference 2 × 3.14 × 5 = 31.4 cm.

faq.q: What is the formula for the area of a circle?
faq.a: A = πr². A circle with radius 5 cm has area 3.14 × 25 = 78.5 cm².

faq.q: What if I only know the diameter?
faq.a: For circumference you can use C = πd. For area, divide the diameter by 2 to get the radius first.

faq.q: What does in terms of π mean?
faq.a: Leave π as a symbol instead of using 3.14. A circle with radius 3 has area 9π and circumference 6π.

items.q: Which formula gives the area of a circle?

sets.title: Working backward and parts of circles

items.q: A circle has circumference 31.4 cm. What is its diameter? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: C = πd, so d = C ÷ π = 31.4 ÷ 3.14 = 10 cm. Not 5: that is the radius.

items.q: A circle has circumference 62.8 cm. What is its diameter? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: C = πd, so d = C ÷ π = 62.8 ÷ 3.14 = 20 cm. Not 10: that is the radius.

items.q: A circle has circumference 18.84 cm. What is its diameter? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: C = πd, so d = C ÷ π = 18.84 ÷ 3.14 = 6 cm. Not 3: that is the radius.

items.q: A circle has circumference 94.2 cm. What is its diameter? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: C = πd, so d = C ÷ π = 94.2 ÷ 3.14 = 30 cm. Not 15: that is the radius.

A circle has area 78.5 ft². What is its radius? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: A = πr², so r² = 78.5 ÷ 3.14 = 25. Then r = 5 ft, because 5 × 5 = 25.

items.q: A circle has area 12.56 ft². What is its radius? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: A = πr², so r² = 12.56 ÷ 3.14 = 4. Then r = 2 ft, because 2 × 2 = 4.

items.q: A circle has area 314 ft². What is its radius? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: A = πr², so r² = 314 ÷ 3.14 = 100. Then r = 10 ft, because 10 × 10 = 100.

items.q: A circle has area 28.26 ft². What is its radius? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: A = πr², so r² = 28.26 ÷ 3.14 = 9. Then r = 3 ft, because 3 × 3 = 9.

items.q: A circle has circumference 18π cm. What is its radius?
items.e: C = 2πr = 18π, so r = 9 cm.

items.q: A circle has area 49π in². What is its diameter?
items.e: A = πr² = 49π, so r² = 49 and r = 7. The diameter is 2 × 7 = 14 in.

items.q: Find the area of a semicircle with radius 4 cm. Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: A full circle has area 3.14 × 4² = 50.24 cm². A semicircle is half of it: 25.12 cm².

items.q: Find the area of a semicircle with radius 10 cm. Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: A full circle has area 3.14 × 10² = 314 cm². A semicircle is half of it: 157 cm².

items.q: Find the area of a quarter circle with radius 6 cm. Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: A full circle has area 3.14 × 6² = 113.04 cm². A quarter circle is one quarter of it: 28.26 cm².

items.q: Find the area of a quarter circle with radius 2 cm. Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: A full circle has area 3.14 × 2² = 12.56 cm². A quarter circle is one quarter of it: 3.14 cm².

items.q: Find the distance around a semicircle with diameter 10 m (the curved part plus the straight edge). Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: Curved part = half of πd = 3.14 × 10 ÷ 2 = 15.7 m. Add the diameter: 15.7 + 10 = 25.7 m. Not 15.7 m: that leaves out the straight edge.

items.q: If the radius of a circle doubles, what happens to its area?
items.e: A = πr². With 2r, A = π(2r)² = 4πr². The circumference only doubles.

items.q: If the radius of a circle doubles, what happens to its circumference?
items.e: C = 2πr. With 2r, C = 2π(2r) = 2 × 2πr, which is twice as long.

items.q: A bike wheel has a diameter of 26 inches. How far does the bike go in one full turn of the wheel? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: One turn = the circumference: C = πd = 3.14 × 26 = 81.64 in.

items.q: A round pizza has a diameter of 14 inches. What is its area? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: r = 7 in. A = 3.14 × 7² = 3.14 × 49 = 153.86 in². Not 615.44: that uses the diameter.

items.q: A circular garden has a radius of 5 m. How much fencing goes around it? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: Fencing goes around, so find the circumference: 2 × 3.14 × 5 = 31.4 m.

items.q: A sprinkler waters a circle with a radius of 6 ft. What area of lawn does it water? Use 3.14 for π.
A circular track has a diameter of 100 m. How far is one lap? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: One lap is the circumference: 3.14 × 100 = 314 m.

items.q: Chloe walks around a circular pond 3 times. The pond has a radius of 20 m. How far does she walk? Use 3.14 for π.
A clock's minute hand is 10 cm long. How far does its tip travel in 1 hour? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: In 1 hour the tip goes all the way around a circle with radius 10 cm: 2 × 3.14 × 10 = 62.8 cm.

items.e: The dog can reach a circle with radius 9 m: A = 3.14 × 81 = 254.34 m².

items.q: A Ferris wheel has a radius of 25 m. How far does a seat travel in one full turn? Use 3.14 for π.
A semicircle window sits on top of a door. The window's diameter is 4 ft. What is the area of the window? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: A full circle with r = 2 ft has area 3.14 × 4 = 12.56 ft². Half of it is 6.28 ft².

items.q: A 12-inch pizza and an 8-inch pizza are both round. About how much more area does the 12-inch pizza have? Use 3.14 for π.
A square is 10 cm on each side. A circle with diameter 10 cm is cut out of it. What area is left? Use 3.14 for π.
items.e: Square: 10 × 10 = 100 cm². Circle: 3.14 × 5² = 78.5 cm². Left: 100 − 78.5 = 21.5 cm².
